wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-005 wires the six hitscan weapon fire actions via one src/vanilla facade (wireHitscanWeapons.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/player/hitscan.ts (aPunch fist, aSaw chainsaw, aFirePistol, aFireShotgun, aFireShotgun2 super-shotgun, aFireCGun chaingun + gunShot/bulletSlope/aim cache/context, HITSCAN_ACTION_COUNT 8, wireHitscanActions; MELEERANGE/MISSILERANGE/BULLET_AIM_RANGE/BULLET_AIM_NUDGE, SAW_ANGLE_STEP/SNAP, SFX_PISTOL/SHOTGN/DSHTGN/SAWFUL/SAWHIT/PUNCH). VANILLA_HITSCAN_WEAPON_INVARIANTS pins five rules (fist/saw MELEERANGE; bullet MISSILERANGE; autoaim BULLET_AIM_RANGE+NUDGE; chainsaw SAW_ANGLE spread/snap; 8 registered actions; fixed weapon sfx ids). The focused test exercises the range/sfx constants, the six callable fire actions, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). Eligible only after the cb296d9 cycle fix + 10-002 completion.
